scores.visual_critic_note: Six of nine cells are blank in the screenshot (staggered init not complete at capture time), and while the three visible shapes use a deliberate Tol bright palette and clean card layout, a gallery where most panels appear empty reads as broken regardless of cause.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Bar/area states correctly use zero baselines and no lie-factor violations, but scale domains are hardcoded ([0,1], [0,1.2]) throughout rather than derived from data, which is typical for a synthetic-data animation demo.
scores.stress_test_note: Purely automated gallery with no user input paths eliminates Update Storm, Infinite Loop, and Mouse-Touch Fight risks; sequential transition chaining via on('end')/Promise is sound, but missing .interrupt() guards and a mutable closure variable in initLineArea are minor latent hazards.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell 3×3 grid is well within small-multiples range, each cell is a self-contained morph unit with restrained single-hue coloring and clear ↔ labels; several cells appear blank in the static screenshot (shapes mid-transition or at zero size), so animation congruence across all 9 simultaneously-looping morphs cannot be assessed without live playback.
flags: Stale Closure (mutable currentBaseline captured in initLineArea attrTween closure)
